generic_name: Activated Charcoal, Causticum, Arabica Coffee Bean, Prasterone, Glycyrrhiza Glabra, Ribes Nigrum Flower Bud, Eleuthero, and Veratrum Album Root
purpose: This combination product is typically used to support adrenal gland function and help the body manage stress and fatigue. It may help improve energy levels, support hormonal balance, and assist the body in recovering from physical or emotional exhaustion. Some formulations are used to help with symptoms of burnout or adrenal fatigue.
how_it_works: Each ingredient plays a slightly different role. The herbal ingredients like Eleuthero and Licorice Root (Glycyrrhiza Glabra) help support your stress response and may naturally boost energy. Prasterone is a hormone building block that your body can use to make other important hormones. The homeopathic ingredients like Causticum and Veratrum Album are used in very tiny, highly diluted amounts believed by homeopathic practitioners to help restore energy and balance in the body.
common_side_effects: This combination is generally considered well tolerated, but some people may experience mild stomach upset, nausea, or loose stools especially from the activated charcoal or licorice root. Licorice root in higher doses may cause mild headache or water retention. Some people may feel slightly jittery or have trouble sleeping if taken too late in the day due to the stimulating herbs.
warnings: Talk to your doctor before using this product if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have high blood pressure, heart problems, kidney disease, or hormone-sensitive conditions. Licorice root and Prasterone can affect hormone levels and blood pressure with long-term use. Activated charcoal can interfere with the absorption of medications and other supplements, so take them at different times. This product is not a substitute for medical treatment, and if you are feeling seriously unwell, please see your doctor.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies depending on the specific product and brand. Generally, adults take 1 to 2 tablets or capsules once or twice daily, preferably in the morning and early afternoon to avoid sleep disruption. Always follow the directions on the product label or as advised by your healthcare provider. Do not exceed the recommended dose.
